assessment_summary: Validation methodology: I inspected file layout and runtime context, verified containers and Drupal bootstrap, exercised HTTP endpoints and the admin UI, ran Drush diagnostics, cross-checked installed modules against the profile's declared install list, and inspected logs/DB. The installation executes and serves its full feature set. Concretely: DDEV containers for web (drupal11, PHP 8.4) and db (mysql 8.0) are healthy; Drush reports Drupal 11.3.17 with Database Connected and bootstrap Successful, install profile 'openculturas', default theme 'opcult', admin theme 'gin'. The front page and all headline routes (events, calendar, locations, magazine, community, categories, search) return HTTP 200 with rendered, themed content and no PHP errors; German localization works. A Drush one-time login yields a working session and the admin content/config/user pages return 200. All 175 enabled modules satisfy the profile's 165 declared install entries; there are no pending database updates and cache rebuild succeeds; the search index reaches 100% after a normal cron run; composer platform requirements all pass. Limitations: (1) I could not reproduce the reported failure of the guide's alternate command 'ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config' because executing it would overwrite the working installation, which the boundaries prohibit; the summary attributes that failure to an upstream service-ordering bug and the successful install used the documented alternative 'ddev composer run si'. (2) There is config drift (193 items only-in-sync, 49 only-in-db, 96 differing), consistent with the profile-install method versus the committed config export; it does not impair operation. (3) Optional/experimental modules openculturas_openstreetmap, openculturas_faq, openculturas_discussions, and openculturas_section are disabled, but they are not among the profile's default install list (the profile install hook enables only openculturas_map, which is enabled), so the state matches canonical profile-install behavior. These caveats do not undermine the conclusion: the installation is complete and operational under the documented method that was actually used.
